fields.description: Issue includes editorials and local political commentary focused on taxation and consumer costs (including milk pricing), discussion of Miami Beach municipal elections and candidates, and criticism of local newspapers and law-enforcement oversight. Reports cover employment and building trends from the Florida Employment Service, a public-safety campaign warning about unsafe automobiles and "hot rod" driving, and a court item involving Judge Wayne Allen. Additional pieces note Miami Chamber of Commerce industrial survey materials, a fundraising campaign for the Children's Home Society of Florida, Memorial Day services by Jewish War Veterans, and entertainment/nightlife listings and advertisements in Greater Miami and Miami Beach.
